bigip_lsp_units.choice: Finish the BIG-IP portions of the LSP in parallel to other efforts
bigip_lsp_units.meaning: The 35 dedicated BIG-IP/F5 units in the original LSP area (iRules, iApps, tmsh, APL, iLX, XC, BIG-IP navigation/report/editor surfaces in tcl-lsp-core, tcl-lsp-server, editors/vscode and editors/zed) are no longer deferred; they are implemented now alongside the other in-scope work.
bigip_lsp_units.supersedes: the earlier deferral of dedicated BIG-IP/iRules/ILX/XC/APL/tmsh semantics for the LSP area

validation_run_updates.choice: The validation agent pushes regular updates of its validation run
validation_run_updates.meaning: While a CI run or capture is in progress, the validation agent commits and pushes current-state.md (and any partial result summaries) at least every 30 minutes and after each completed group or shard, not only at the end.
